items.title: Apple, Taiwan Semi Lead Five Stocks Near Buy Points
items.summary: Apple, which just unveiled its first foldable iPhone and two other new models that go on sale this week, and Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing, which makes the chips that power them, lead this weekend's watch list of five top stocks near buy points.  Joining AAPL and TSM are cloud-based communications software platform Twilio and two healthcare plays.  Oscar Health is the No. 2 health insurer based on Affordable Care Act exchange membership.

items.title: Sirius XM CEO Highlights Cash Flow Growth, New Sports Plans and Ad Expansion at Conference
items.summary: Jennifer Witz, chief executive officer of Sirius XM (NASDAQ:SIRI), said the company’s strategy remains centered on strengthening its subscription business, expanding advertising and improving efficiency, with recent operating results providing what she described as evidence that the approach is work

items.title: Qualcomm Lost Apple’s Modem Business. Amazon Just Offered a $60 Billion Escape Route.
items.summary: Qualcomm is watching Apple walk out the door with its modem business, but a surprise Amazon partnership promises a $60 billion lifeline built on unproven silicon in a market already owned by rivals. Whether that door holds the weight is the real question.
